prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one isolated complete Novoferma food package packshot with genuine alpha transparency for the same catalogue product family.
Inputs and roles: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET for the entire physical package, its camera angle, proportions and material construction. Image 2 is a food detail reference for a half sphere and pale fibrous chicken cross-section. Image 3 is a food appearance reference for whole browned spheres with green flecks. Image 4 is the exact friendly orange cartoon chicken identity and white apron with green grid, for a printed mascot illustration on the new label.
Primary request: adapt ONLY the printed label identity and visible contents of Image 1 into the new product «ФИБРИКИ». Keep the exact same cream curved cardboard sleeve, bowed top, curved lower sleeve edge, brown inner sleeve side wings, clear plastic tub visibly extending below the sleeve, complete natural rounded lower tub rim, low front three-quarter camera, package perspective and restrained composition. Nearly exact same cream paper colour and subtle texture as Image 1, not a flat modern box or a pouch.
Printed label hierarchy, centered and accurately spelled: top center orange "NOVOferma" logo, matching the supplied package. Below it a VERY LARGE elegant dark-brown serif uppercase Cyrillic product name "ФИБРИКИ", same family typographic character as Image 1. Under the title a smaller widely tracked sans-serif uppercase line "ФРИКАДЕЛЬКИ ИЗ КУРИЦЫ". Under that a small clean uppercase line "С ПИЩЕВЫМИ ВОЛОКНАМИ". Add a tasteful small orange handwritten note "Белок + клетчатка".
Lower-left printed serving photo on the sleeve: two browned golden whole chicken spheres with green flecks plus one half sphere exposing a pale fibrous chicken cut face. Follow Images 2 and 3 for the food texture and colour. These are chicken fibres, not a rice claim. All three serving pieces are printed photorealistic imagery on the label, NOT physical food outside the package.
Right of the printed food: one printed orange cartoon chicken matching Image 4's face, colours, drawing style and white green-grid apron. A dynamic one-leg running pose, delighted, with one wing reaching toward the pictured food, composition and illustration scale consistent with the existing packaging family.
Actual physical tub contents visible below the curved sleeve: pale frozen round chicken meatballs with subtle green flecks, clearly visible through clean transparent plastic. Keep contents frozen and pale, distinct from the browned serving food printed above.
Allowed printed text is ONLY: "NOVOferma", "ФИБРИКИ", "ФРИКАДЕЛЬКИ ИЗ КУРИЦЫ", "С ПИЩЕВЫМИ ВОЛОКНАМИ", "Белок + клетчатка". Remove the old product title and all old copy from Image 1 completely: no "КЛАССИЧЕСКИЕ", no standalone old heading "ФРИКАДЕЛЬКИ", no "100% НАТУРАЛЬНО", no old microcopy. No other characters, badges, percentages, certifications, nutrition figures, mass, price, ingredients block or extra factual claims.
Composition/output: ONE whole package centered on a square canvas. Package around 92% of canvas width, with approximately 9% transparent vertical margins and enough space around every edge. No clipping. Genuinely transparent surroundings right up to the physical object edge, with natural clean continuous antialiasing. Keep physical cardboard side wings and complete rounded clear tub rim; remove every cast/contact shadow OUTSIDE the product, no brown pad, no white halo, no hard cutoff, no ground or floor. No baked-in external shadow; website CSS adds it. No website, hands, moodboard, flat label panel, mockup panel or extra objects. Output only the complete isolated packaged product.

Use case: compositing.
Asset type: ONE complete new Novoferma product catalogue packshot on a genuine transparent square canvas.

Input image 1 is the PHYSICAL PACKAGE EDIT TARGET: the current Novoferma bitочки package. Keep exactly its physical low-front three-quarter camera angle, scale, natural cream curved paper sleeve construction, clear tub visible BELOW the sleeve, and complete rounded clear plastic lower rim. Remove and replace ALL old БИТОЧКИ label artwork and food. Input image 2 is a PACKAGING FAMILY reference only: same restrained cream/brown/orange palette and elegant Cyrillic serif typography, photographically believable paper and transparent plastic. Input image 3 is the FOOD SHAPE reference: elongated oval mini chicken sausages with visible tiny green herbs and red vegetable flecks, clearly long rounded ovals, never round meatballs or flat cutlets. Input image 4 is MASCOT IDENTITY: same friendly orange hen, expressive eyes, brand linework, white apron with green grid.

Design the NEW printed sleeve front as follows:
- Top center: orange NOVOferma logo, same family mark as references.
- Main title, very large and readable: exact Cyrillic "ЛЮЛЯ МИНИ", in one elegant dark-brown serif line if possible, matching the established package typography rather than a chunky sans-serif website headline.
- Immediately below, smaller widely tracked uppercase Cyrillic: exact "КУРИНЫЕ КОЛБАСКИ".
- Next line, same restrained smaller type: exact "С ЗЕЛЕНЬЮ И ОВОЩАМИ".
- Lower-left PRINTED ON THE SLEEVE: appetizing photoreal serving image of three browned elongated oval mini chicken sausages matching input image 3. A tiny natural parsley leaf and red tomato accent may accompany them.
- Right PRINTED ON THE SLEEVE: lively orange hen from input image 4 in a white green-grid apron, presenting a serving plate of those same oval mini sausages, preserving the expressive eyes and characteristic brand linework.
The food serving image and illustrated hen are FLAT PRINTED LABEL ART following the sleeve perspective, not real standalone items outside the packaging.
The ACTUAL transparent plastic tub below the sleeve visibly contains pale frozen elongated oval mini chicken sausages with small green and red flecks. Keep the full smooth naturally rounded bottom rim and convincing clear-plastic highlights.

Text whitelist: ONLY "NOVOferma", "ЛЮЛЯ МИНИ", "КУРИНЫЕ КОЛБАСКИ", and "С ЗЕЛЕНЬЮ И ОВОЩАМИ". No other words. No weight, percentage, nutrition, price, certification, 100% natural claim or invented ingredient block. Remove every old text line and old artwork from the edit target.

Composition: complete isolated physical package, square canvas, approximately 92% canvas width, centered with balanced roughly 9% top and bottom margins, matching the current catalogue's package size and low-front viewpoint. Natural cream paper, dark brown typography, orange logo; palette restrained to the current packaging family.
Background/alpha: genuine transparency everywhere outside the physical package, no studio backdrop. Clean complete antialiased outer rim. NO ground shadow, NO contact shadow outside the tub, NO brown shadow pad, NO jagged mask, NO white halo, NO hard horizontal bottom cutoff. No website, moodboard, extra package, or additional standalone chicken.
